answer: Re-attestations are stored in haven and jade lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, which means holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the juniper graph. A farm of 3207 identities would post 3411 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
